meta.title: AssemblyPress first viable version
meta.description: Sets up a demo site that proves the AssemblyPress member/profile loop with profile schema, member editing, and public blocks.
meta.author: AssemblyPress contributors

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';

$plugin_path = '';
foreach ( array( 'assemblypress/assemblypress.php', 'AssemblyPress/assemblypress.php' ) as $candidate ) {
	if ( file_exists( WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/' . $candidate ) ) {
		$plugin_path = $candidate;
		break;
	}
}

if ( ! $plugin_path ) {
	throw new RuntimeException( 'AssemblyPress is not mounted in wp-content/plugins.' );
}

if ( ! is_plugin_active( $plugin_path ) ) {
	$result = activate_plugin( $plugin_path );

	if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
		throw new RuntimeException( $result->get_error_message() );
	}
}

$setup_file = WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/' . dirname( $plugin_path ) . '/blueprints/first-viable-version.php';

if ( ! file_exists( $setup_file ) ) {
	throw new RuntimeException( 'AssemblyPress demo setup file is missing.' );
}

require $setup_file;
